broker.name: Axiory
broker.tagline: Its site names FSC (Belize) and FSC (Mauritius). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:2000.
broker.about: Axiory publishes this address: No. 1 Corner of William Fonseca Street, Marine Parade, Belize City, Belize. The pages checked do not state a founding year. Account names on its site include Nano, Standard, Max, Tera, Alpha, and Zero. Platforms named there include MT4, MT5, and cTrader. The site names these regulators: FSC (Belize) and FSC (Mauritius). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:2000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Leverage page: 1:2000 when combined equity with credit is 0 to 2,000 USD/EUR, then steps down to 1:50 above 500,001 USD/EUR.
Same equity table caps them at 1:1000 until 3,333 USD/EUR, then lower.
Homepage: up to 1:2000 on Max accounts, subject to equity tiers.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.note: Account comparison lists 10 USD for Nano, Standard, Max, Tera and Zero, and n/a for Alpha. FAQ says the minimum deposit is 10 USD, or 100 USD by bank wire. Not one number.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, licence page, account comparison, leverage page and terms PDF fetched. Homepage says over 15 years of experience and does not give a founding year. Belize licence conflict: licence page and terms say 4496214; the registration FAQ also says License No. 000122/29 and, elsewhere on that saved FAQ text, 000122/8. Tradit Ltd GB21026376 is on the licence page as Mauritius FSC. FAQ also describes Walletory as a Major Payment Institution licensed by MAS in Singapore. That is not entered as an Axiory broker licence. The Belize street address is the published registered office and site contact address.
